Technology stocks were adding to their prior small gains, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were adding almost 0.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was climbing more than 0.6% during late trading.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Nvidia Corp ( NVDA ) rose as much as 5% on Friday after analysts at Evercore ISI raised their price target for the specialty chipmaker by $100 - or 33.3% - over their prior view to $400 a share while reiterating an Outperform rating for the company's stock.
In other sector news:
(+) BlackBerry (BB,BB.TO) was over 13% higher during Friday trading after the networking equipment and software firm reported better-than-expected Q2 financial results. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $0.04 per share, beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.01 per share. Revenue fell to $210 million from $238 million in the year-ago period, matching analyst estimates.
(+) CaIAmp ( CAMP ) shares climbed over 9% at one point on Friday after the telematics management company exceeded Wall Street expectations with its Q2 financial results. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $0.31 per share during the three months ended August 31, up from a $0.27 per share non-GAAP profit in the year-ago period and beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.03 per share. Revenue rose 7% year-over-year to $96 million, also topping the $95.4 million analyst mean.
(-) Progress Software Corp ( PRGS ) plunged as much as 18% on Friday, falling within 17 cents of its 52-week low of $34.72 a share, after reporting fiscal Q3 revenue and forecasting below-consensus Q4 financial results. Revenue fell 2% during the three months ended August 31 compared with the same quarter last year to $95.7 million, missing the $97 million Capital IQ consensus. For Q4, the industrial software firm is projecting adjusted net income in a range of $0.71 to $0.74 per share on between $107 million to $110 million in revenue. Analysts, on average, are looking for a $0.78 per share non-GAAP Q4 profit on $116.7 million in revenue.
